known_limits.note: The wiki index source (discovery/sources.txt) failed in GitHub Actions run 41921300975 (https://github.com/traceroute87/RetroHatch/actions/runs/41921300975), as reported by the maintainer; the cause has not been analysed. Generic page-following stays in the crawler until the index source is proven. Wiki rows in this file come from earlier crawls and the 2026-11-04 page check, not from that run.
The wiki page text was never saved, only its links: wiki headings and descriptions are not recorded, and categories of wiki-only rows come from the file name.

Only the collection members with tracked per-item evidence are itemized (funkey_sdl2_games: 7). The 43 games of joyrider3774/32blit_funkey and the 29 picoarch core launchers are known from untracked crawl results and are not listed. BEFORE IMPORT: that evidence lives only under the git-ignored build/crawl*/ directories (per-game names, ZIP members, sizes, tag URLs). Copy it into a tracked file first, or it is lost with the build directory.
Entries with evidence.audit come from docs/GITHUB_COVERAGE_AUDIT.md prose: their packages were not inspected, sizes and hashes are unknown, and source-only entries have no release package.
System add-ons named in the audit (SimpleMenu for RG Nano, FunKey Add-on, AdvanceMAME bundle) have no tracked URL and are not listed.
